article.linkText: Minnesota squares off against Purdue in Big Ten play
article.story: Minnesota (4-1) at Purdue (2-3), Oct. 10 at 8 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Minnesota by 2.5. Against the spread: Minnesota 4-1, Purdue 2-2-1. How to watch: BTN Key stats Minnesota Offense Overall: 354.6 yards per game (99th in FBS) Passing: 234.2 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 120.4 yards per game (116th) Scoring: 32 points per game (62nd) Minnesota Defense Overall: 253.8 yards per game (12th in FBS) Passing: 159.8 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 94 yards per game (19th) Scoring: 18 points per game (35th) Purdue Offense Overall: 405.8 yards per game (59th in FBS) Passing: 306.6 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 99.2 yards per game (130th) Scoring: 30.4 points per game (69th) Purdue Defense Overall: 425.8 yards per game (128th in FBS) Passing: 242.2 yards per game (111th) Rushing: 183.6 yards per game (118th) Scoring: 35 points per game (129th) Purdue ranks 135th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 51.7% of the time. Minnesota ranks 83rd on offense, converting on 38.6% of third downs. Purdue is 104th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90.9% of trips. Minnesota's red zone offense ranks 13th, scoring on 95.5% of red zone opportunities. Minnesota is 4th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 34:45. Team leaders Minnesota Passing: Drake Lindsey, 1,087 yards, 8 TDs, 4 INTs, 66.9 completion percentage Rushing: TJ Thomas Jr., 307 yards on 46 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Noah Jennings, 345 yards on 26 catches, 1 TD Purdue Passing: Ryan Browne, 1,390 yards, 8 TDs, 1 INT, 70.5 completion percentage Rushing: Fame Ijeboi, 354 yards on 86 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Asaad Waseem, 453 yards on 27 catches, 1 TD Last game Minnesota beat Michigan 20-14 on Oct. 3. Lindsey led Minnesota with 136 yards on 17-of-25 passing (68.0%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. Thomas had 56 rushing yards on 12 carries, adding two receptions for 14 yards. Jennings had seven receptions for 70 yards. Purdue beat Illinois 24-17 on Oct. 3. Browne passed for 255 yards on 18-of-27 attempts (66.7%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Ijeboi had 65 rushing yards on 19 carries, adding one reception for 10 yards. Waseem had three receptions for 98 yards. Next game Minnesota hosts No. 20 Iowa on Oct. 24. Purdue hosts Washington on Oct. 16.
